entities.name: Sacred Duty of Hospitality
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Nearly every ancient culture held hospitality as a sacred duty. Refusing food and shelter to a stranger violated divine law — Greek xenia, Arabic diyafa, Norse gestrisni. Travelers depended on this custom for survival in a world without inns, roads, or police.
